paragraphs: Huna Mar, son of Rav Idi [אירי in heading], in Ravina’s and Rabbi Adda bar Minyomi’s time: Chullin 49a. They asked Ravina. Rav Yehudah said to Rav Nachman, “Did the master not hear what Rav Huna bar Idi said in Shmuel’s name?” (See his entry.)
